verdict.rationale: Instinct's own docs say it is 'trained to use a phone and a computer', can see your screen, and can sign into third-party accounts with your credentials to act and make purchases on your behalf. Community reports describe it finding cheap flights and booking travel, and note it gets bot-blocked on airline and card sites and that sites can't tell it from a scraper, which implies it operates websites directly. However, browser control is never explicitly documented, and testers report slowness, bot-blocking, and wrong bookings. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of web-browser operation, detail on how research and browsing tasks are performed, reliable website task completion without bot-blocking or booking errors.
